Assam Police Detain 330 in Statewide Fraud Crackdown

Assam Police have detained approximately 330 individuals across the state in a crackdown targeting fraudulent activities, including extortion and impersonation. The operation, led by the Director General of Police (DGP), involved a statewide sweep. Authorities are continuing to investigate the allegations of fraud and extortion linked to those detained.
